questions.question: What is a prompt?
options: An instruction or request given to an AI system

questions.question: Why is writing a good prompt important?
options: It speeds up your internet connection
It helps AI generate more accurate and useful responses

questions.question: Which prompt is better?
options: Explain digital marketing to beginners using simple language and five practical examples.

questions.question: Why should you provide context in a prompt?
options: To help AI better understand your request

questions.question: Which of the following should you specify when writing a prompt?
What is a common prompting mistake?
If the AI's first response is not satisfactory, what should you do?
options: Refine your prompt or ask the AI to improve its response

questions.question: Why is it important to specify the target audience?
options: It helps AI adjust the language and level of detail

questions.question: Which task can AI assist with when given a good prompt?
What should you do before using important AI-generated information?
options: Verify its accuracy using reliable sources
